project_summary: Adversarial pre-implementation architecture validator, GitHub prior-art & pain-point scout, and HTML/Mermaid.js Blueprint generator.

problem.label: Problem & User Pain
problem.summary: Eliminates yes-man AI validation and post-hoc-only diagramming by forcing Socratic architecture grilling and real GitHub issue pain-point mining before code is written.
edge_cases: Developers jumping straight to code without checking Graveyard Repos
Post-hoc tools (GitDiagram/DeepWiki) require an existing repo and cannot validate pre-code ideas

scope.label: Scope & Non-Goals
scope.summary: Scoped as a native Agent Skill (SKILL.md + deterministic Python scripts for state, GitHub scouting, and HTML blueprint rendering) that hands off into /to-spec, /to-tickets, and /tdd.
edge_cases: Avoids duplicating host LLM orchestration inside a separate Gemini CLI loop

memory.label: State & Persistence (Memory)
memory.summary: Hybrid 3-tier persistence: git-friendly JSON/Markdown for Working State (.preflight/state.json) and Decision Ledger (docs/adr/*.md + .preflight/decisions.json), plus SQLite (.preflight/cache.db) with 7-day TTL for GitHub Repo Cache.
edge_cases: Downstream coding agents read docs/adr/ and GLOSSARY.md natively without querying SQLite

bottlenecks.label: Bottlenecks & Failure Modes
bottlenecks.summary: Mitigates GitHub API rate limits (60/hr unauthenticated) via gh auth token -> GITHUB_TOKEN -> unauthenticated fallback chain, SQLite TTL caching, and noise/spam repo filtering.
edge_cases: Unauthenticated fallback automatically reduces query breadth to prevent HTTP 403 rate-limit crashes
Keyword-stuffed spam repos are filtered out via in:name,description scoping

differentiation.label: Prior-Art Differentiation
differentiation.summary: Directly solves top mined open issues in OpenSpec (#1176 built-in HTML artifact viewer, #900 SDD-to-TDD bridge) and GitDiagram (#4 & #112 local CLI/repo execution) while avoiding the rigid monolithic process that caused gsd-build/get-shit-done (64k stars) to be archived.
edge_cases: Combines live GitHub Graveyard & Pain-Point Mining with mattpocock/skills handoff

red_team_critiques.title: Double-LLM Orchestration Trap
red_team_critiques.attack: Building a standalone gemini-2.5-flash CLI inside an AI coding workspace forces users to manage duplicate API keys, splits conversation history, and blocks native file/subagent tool access.
red_team_critiques.mitigation: ADR-0001: Package PreFlight as a host-orchestrated Agent Skill (SKILL.md) paired with deterministic Python helper scripts.

red_team_critiques.title: GitHub Search Rate-Limit & Keyword-Spam Poisoning
red_team_critiques.attack: Unauthenticated GitHub Search API allows only 10 req/min (60/hr), and broad README searches return keyword-stuffed political/spam repos that pollute Pain-Point Mining.
red_team_critiques.mitigation: Authenticate via gh auth token -> GITHUB_TOKEN -> unauthenticated fallback, scope queries with in:name,description, filter spam heuristics, and cache in SQLite (.preflight/cache.db) with a 7-day TTL.

red_team_critiques.title: Opaque SQLite State Hiding ADRs from Coding Agents
red_team_critiques.attack: Storing ADRs and Working State exclusively inside a binary SQLite file prevents downstream skills (/to-spec, /to-tickets, /tdd) and git diffs from inspecting architectural decisions.
red_team_critiques.mitigation: ADR-0002: Hybrid persistence — Markdown ADRs (docs/adr/) + JSON state (.preflight/*.json) for humans/agents, and SQLite strictly for Tier 3 Repo Cache.

flowchart TD
    Dev(["Developer"]) -->|"/preflight or idea pitch"| Skill["PreFlight Agent Skill (SKILL.md)"]
    Skill -->|"Round 1..N Frontier Questions"| Griller["Socratic Griller & Readiness Gate (5x20% Rubric)"]
    Skill -->|"Inline Term Resolution"| Glossary["GLOSSARY.md (Domain Model)"]
    Griller -->|"state.py"| StateJSON[(".preflight/state.json & decisions.json")]
    Griller -->|"state.py add-decision"| ADRs["docs/adr/NNNN-*.md"]
    Skill -->|"Async after Round 1 (scout.py)"| Scout["GitHub Deep-Scout & Pain-Point Miner"]
    Scout <-->|"7-day TTL"| CacheDB[(".preflight/cache.db SQLite3")]
    Scout -->|"Active Incumbents, Graveyard, Pain Points"| PriorArtJSON[(".preflight/prior-art.json")]
    PriorArtJSON -->|"Live Ammunition for Round 2+"| Griller
    StateJSON & PriorArtJSON -->|"Gate >= 80% (render_blueprint.py)"| Blueprint["blueprint_report.html (Interactive Mermaid + Red-Team)"]
    Blueprint -->|"Downstream Handoff"| Downstream["/to-spec -> /to-tickets -> /implement + /tdd"]

sequenceDiagram
    actor Dev as Developer

    par Async GitHub Prior-Art Scout
        Agent->>Scout: Execute scoped repo & open-issue queries
        Scout-->>Agent: Active Incumbents, Graveyard Repos (>365d), Mined Pain Points (+1 issues)
    and Rubric & ADR Recording

    end

options_matrix.pros: Zero extra LLM API keys; native access to host subagents; deterministic SQLite caching & HTML rendering.
options_matrix.cons: Requires host AI coding agent (Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor).

options_matrix.pros: Runs in a bare terminal without an IDE agent.
options_matrix.cons: Duplicates host LLM loop; requires separate API key; isolated from workspace agent skills.
Useless before code is written; zero adversarial grilling or issue pain-point mining.

implementation_steps: 1. Configure repo agent conventions (AGENTS.md, docs/agents/*, GLOSSARY.md, docs/adr/).
2. Implement Tier 1 & Tier 2 state & ADR ledger manager (skills/preflight/scripts/state.py).
3. Implement Tier 3 SQLite GitHub Deep-Scout & Pain-Point Miner (skills/preflight/scripts/scout.py).
4. Implement Readiness-Gated dark-mode HTML + Mermaid.js Blueprint renderer (skills/preflight/scripts/render_blueprint.py).
5. Package SKILL.md, verify with automated unit tests (tests/test_preflight.py), and install globally to ~/.gemini/config/skills/preflight.
